title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt blends three rich fruit flavours for a full-bodied, layered vape. Blueberry leads with its sweet, slightly jammy character, while Cherry adds a darker, more rounded depth. Cranberry cuts through the richness with a bright, tart edge, giving the overall profile a satisfying balance of sweet and sharp notes. This flavour is ideal for fans of mixed berry vapes that offer more depth and nuance than standard blends, with a complexity that still feels clean and consistent on the inhale. With a 50VG/50PG base, this Nic Salt is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it delivers fast nicotine relief and a smooth throat hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
